query:
SELECT
                    p.name,
                    pe.elo,
                    COALESCE(
                        array_agg((
                            c.name,
                            cp.letter
                        )),
                        ARRAY[]::RECORD[]
                    ) AS "contests!: Vec<ProblemContest>"
                FROM problems p
                JOIN problem_elos pe
                    ON pe.problem_id = p.id
                JOIN contest_problems cp
                    ON cp.problem_id = p.id
                JOIN contests c
                    ON c.id = cp.contest_id
                GROUP BY p.id, p.name, pe.elo
                ORDER BY pe.elo DESC
